Kaishi TV plugin runtime dependency notices

The licenses in this directory apply to the named dependencies, separately from the
MIT license of the original Kaishi TV host and test fixtures. Exact versions,
upstream URLs and license file SHA-256 values are listed in dependencies.json.

Python packages were obtained from PyPI and the official Chaquopy Android wheel
index (https://chaquo.com/pypi-13.1/). Their wheel license files are preserved here;
jsonpath's MIT copyright/license block is preserved from its distributed source
because that wheel has no separate LICENSE file. CPython's license was obtained
from the exact v3.10.15 tag. Chaquopy's source and reproducible Python target build
recipes are available at https://github.com/chaquo/chaquopy/tree/16.1.0.

The SQLite component is dedicated to the public domain by its authors. See
https://sqlite.org/copyright.html. liblzma is the XZ library component; XZ command
line tools are not shipped. See xz-5.4.6-COPYING.txt for its component-specific terms.

The unmodified certifi certificate data is MPL-2.0 covered source. A matching
source distribution is available at https://pypi.org/project/certifi/2026.10.23/#files.
No third-party provider plugin or drpy implementation is included in this directory.
